decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system remains a specialist, standards-driven line that fits the firm's robust application-specific portfolio, even after the marine searchlight range was pruned.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the firm's ergonomic workplace offering, but as a more standalone product family it faces higher review risk than core integrated lighting lines.
This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's mainstream building-lighting business and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn in the coming year.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics was positioned as a flagship direction product, so management would normally continue backing it rather than remove it soon after launch.
